STUDIO V Architecture is a design driven studio-based architectural and urban practice located in New York City. Our practice is dedicated to creating innovative contemporary architecture and urban design that seeks to reinvent the potential of the city the 21st century city. The focus of our work is new buildings, innovative adaptive reuse, creative public spaces, and the transformation of urban edges, gaps, and interstices to make communities more sustainable, resilient, livable.
We are seeking talented designers who are highly creative, have excellent academic backgrounds, and conceptual design skills with strong technical knowledge to turn ideas into reality

Our Studio engages in a diverse clientele and an extraordinary range of project types. We foster an open studio environment and culture that shares, discusses and tests ideas. Our work is focused on contemporary expressions of form, materials, and fabrication to create new expressions in the urban landscape. STUDIO V Architecture is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer exciting projects, and excellent benefits.
